shared_elements: single large anthropomorphic figure filling the field
head with elaborate headdress/headgear at top
ornament worn on the body (disc pendant on chest / earring and necklace)
incised surface patterning indicating garment or ornament
head-and-upper-body composition occupying the whole surface
justification: Both depict a single dominant human(oid) figure with a distinct headdress and worn ornaments occupying the entire field, which is about as generic as figural iconography gets. They differ fundamentally in the specific forms: A is a frontal, blocky, heavily schematic figure with a large circular chest disc and no rendered facial or feather detail, while B is a strict profile head-and-shoulders with naturalistic eye, nose, ringleted beard, earring and a densely feathered wing — no shared distinctive motif or relationship beyond "a figure wearing a headdress."
